title: Without AP/AR Data and Customers View the deposit toast has no button
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Work orders → Create & Edit' but neither 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' nor 'Customers → View', at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, billed to customer B, holding one deposit of $10.00 taken on its Finance tab after customer B was picked.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Bill To field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • An error toast shows "This work order has a $10.00 deposit from [customer B's name]. Reverse it, change the Bill To, then take the deposit again under the new Bill To."
  • The toast has no "Open Deposits" button.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • S5-N2: “Without 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' and 'Customers → View', the M1 toast shows with no button.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

  • bt-p3-12-after-phone-tap.png

The design's own words:

  • “Error toast: "This work order has a $10.00 deposit from 7 Star Truck Repair. Reverse it, change the Bill To, then take the deposit again under the new Bill To." with "Close" only.”
  • “Details open, the Bill To field tapped (it sits below the fold, under the toast). The same toast, "Close" only. A tap never depends on a hover.”
  • “Error toast with the same words and "Go To Invoice" and "Close". "Go To Invoice" opens the Finance tab; it never reverses anything.”

Difference BT-D02 on S5-N2 (BT-D02 Close): this case follows the PRD; the design's version is asked in question 5.
